description: This file contains functions and constants for managing curriculum content, structure, and localization in the FreeCodeCamp project. It includes path resolution, configuration retrieval, and file operations related to curriculum challenges, blocks, and superblocks.

methods.name: getContentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves directory paths for curriculum content based on language and optional overrides, asserting existence of i18n directories for non-English languages.

methods.name: getContentDir
methods.description: Returns the content directory path for a specified language, choosing between default and i18n directories.

methods.name: getCurriculumStructure
methods.description: Reads and parses the curriculum JSON file to return superblocks and certifications.

methods.name: getBlockStructurePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a block's structure JSON file.

methods.name: getBlockStructureDir
methods.description: Returns the directory containing block structure files.

methods.name: createBlockFolder
methods.description: Creates a new directory for a block within the curriculum content directory.

methods.name: getBlockStructure
methods.description: Reads and parses a block's structure JSON file.

methods.name: writeBlockStructure
methods.description: Formats and writes a block's structure JSON to file, using prettier for formatting.

methods.name: writeSuperblockStructure
methods.description: Formats and writes a superblock's structure JSON to file, using prettier for formatting.

methods.name: getSuperblockStructure
methods.description: Reads and parses a superblock's structure JSON file.

methods.name: getSuperblockStructurePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a superblock's structure JSON file.

methods.name: getLanguageConfig
methods.description: Retrieves language-specific configuration paths for curriculum content, asserting existence of i18n directories for non-English languages.
